title: Highly sensitive and selective electrochemical determination of curcumin using a polyaniline-based molecularly imprinted polymer
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27692-27700
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA03086F, Paper
Open Access

Amir Abbas Rafati, Esmaeil Karami
A novel and highly selective electrochemical sensor based on a polyaniline molecularly imprinted polymer modified glassy carbon electrode (MIP–PANI/GCE) was developed for the determination of curcumin.
